title: Electrical stimulation of temporal and limbic circuitry produces distinct responses in human ventral temporal cortex
description: Intracranial EEG recordings from five patients undergoing clinical monitoring at the Mayo Clinic, collected during single pulse electrical stimulation. The dataset supports identification of distinct basis profile curves in human ventral temporal cortex evoked by stimulation of temporal and limbic circuitry. Analysis code is available in an accompanying GitHub repository.
methods_description: Patients rested in a hospital bed while single pulse electrical stimulation was delivered at approximately 0.2 Hz. Stimulation pulses were biphasic, 200 microseconds in duration, with an amplitude of 6 mA.
